title: BA1/215/2015 of Jagmohan Vs State Of Uttarakhand

paras.text:
B.A.1 No. 215 of 2015
U.C. Dhyani, J. Ms. Anjali Noliyal, Advocate for the applicant.
Mr. Hari Om Bhakuni, A.G.A. with Ms. Geeta
Parihar, Brief Holder for the respondent State.
 Applicant Jagmohan seeks bail in connection
with case crime no. 81 of 2013, under Sections 363,
370(5), 344, 120B IPC, registered at Police Station,
G.R.P. Haridwar, District Haridwar.
Heard learned counsel for the parties, considered
the grounds taken in the bail application and perused
the documents on record.
An FIR was lodged against unknown accused on
04.09.2013. After the investigation, a final report was
submitted by the Investigating Officer on 04.04.2014.
The kidnapped child was produced before the CJM,
Haridwar by his parents. The victim's parents filed an
undertaking before the S.O., GRP, Haridwar that the
victim is in their custody and they will produce him as
and when required by the Court.
Co-accused Balvinder Singh, with similar role,
was granted bail by this Court on 08.01.2015,
primarily, because when the kidnapped child was
recovered from the possession of the applicant and
others, they said that they will be handing over the
child to Balvinder Singh. Applicant is in jail since
06.09.2014, and he is not a pervious convict.
Considering the other aspects of the case, as also
attenuating circumstances, this Court is of the opinion
that the applicant should be enlarged on bail on the
ground of parity.
Bail application is allowed. Let the applicant be
released on bail on his executing a personal bond and
furnishing two reliable sureties, each of like amount to
the satisfaction of the C.J.M., Haridwar.
